title: [Communication] Senior Manager, Core Capabilities HUB Japan [IM]
description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Function: 

Communications & Corporate/External Affairs

Job Sub Function: 

Multi-Family Communications & Corporate/External Affairs

Job Category:

People Leader

All Job Posting Locations:

Chiyoda, Tokyo, Japan

Job Description:

Job Description and Key Responsibilities

The Senior Manager, Core Capabilities HUB, Japan is accountable for leading the Japan implementation of the CPA HUB model, ensuring that Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine Communications & Public Affairs operates with strategic consistency, operational excellence, and measurable impact in one of the company’s largest markets.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Japan Communications & Public Affairs, this role serves as the Japan leader responsible for deploying, integrating, and optimizing core CPA capabilities—including digital, media and issues management, results and measurement, internal and executive communications enablement, brand guidance, self-service capabilities, and operational governance—in close alignment with the Global HUB strategy and standards.

Operating at the intersection of global strategy and Japan execution, the Senior Manager partners closely with Japan CPA Therapeutic Area leads and regional CPA team to ensure the HUB capabilities function as a force multiplier for commercial impact, reducing duplication, accelerating execution, and enabling agile deployment of resources at business‑critical moments.  

In this model, the Global HUB defines strategy, standards, and system-level consistency, while the Japan HUB ensures disciplined execution, adoption, and performance of those capabilities locally.  

Key Responsibilities

HUB Strategy & Implementation Lead the Japan HUB strategy and execution, translating global HUB vision, governance, and capability standards into effective local operating models, ways of working, and delivery plans 
Drive adoption of HUB capabilities and ensure alignment with enterprise and Innovative Medicine priorities 
Ensure HUB activities are focused on the highest-value commercial and reputational opportunities in Japan 

 

Core Capability Stewardship Serve as the primary steward of core CPA capabilities in Japan, including:  Digital and social platforms 
Media and issues management 
Results, measurement, and analytics 
Internal communications enablement and self-service models 
Executive communications support 
Brand governance and operational systems  

Ensure consistent, high-quality deployment of these capabilities in alignment with global standards 

 

Business Partnership & Prioritization Partner closely with the Senior Director, Communications & Public Affairs, Japan and local Therapeutic Area Communications leads to align HUB resources to business priorities and critical moments 
Support integrated planning and execution across launches, data readouts, congresses, and key issues 
Act as a strategic partner to ensure communications capabilities drive business impact and reputation outcomes 

 

Governance, Risk & Operational Excellence Ensure consistent application of enterprise governance, compliance, and risk management practices across communications activities in Japan  
Establish and reinforce clear processes, standards, and ways of working aligned to the HUB model 
Drive operational discipline, scalability, and efficiency across communication executions 

 

Measurement, Insights & Continuous Improvement Oversee implementation of measurement and performance analytics, ensuring alignment with global frameworks 
Partner with global teams to demonstrate impact, inform decision-making, and optimize resource allocation 
Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and capability enhancement across the HUB 

 

Agile Execution & Resource Deployment Enable flexible resourcing and rapid execution to support priority business moments 
Coordinate with global and regional HUB teams to ensure access to the right expertise and tools 
Support efficient scaling of capabilities across priority initiatives 

 

Global HUB Integration Act as the primary liaison between Japan and Global HUB, ensuring a strong two-way flow of insights, best practices, and feedback 
Contribute to global capability evolution by sharing Japan market insights, needs, and lessons learned 
Ensure strong alignment across global, regional, and local teams 

Qualifications – External

Education
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in Communications, Journalism, Business, Public Policy, or a related field preferred.

Experience and Skills

Required:

Minimum of 8-12 years of experience in communications, public affairs, or related roles within complex, matrixed organizations
Clear understanding of the Japan biopharmaceutical environment, including commercialization, policy, reputational risk, and stakeholder dynamics
Proven ability to translate global strategy into local execution with discipline and impact
Experience driving operational excellence, governance, and change in large, distributed teams
Executive presence with the ability to influence senior leaders and operate as a trusted advisor
Preferred:

Experience working in or closely with global priority markets, particularly Japan
Exposure to enterprise or center‑of‑excellence models within communications or public affairs
Experience partnering with Digital, Technology, Analytics, or Enterprise Communications functions
Other:

Up to 10-20% travel, primarily domestic

 

 

Required Skills: 

 

 

Preferred Skills:

Agile Decision Making, Branding, Brand Reputation Management, Communications Measurement, Communication Trends, Corporate Communications Strategy, Corporate Management, Cultural Communications, Developing Others, Inclusive Leadership, Integrated Marketing Communications, Leadership, Mentorship, Project Management Tools, Regulatory Environment, Relationship Building, Risk Assessments, Stakeholder Engagement, Team Management
